title: List and abandon managed retirements stuck in purging
summary: With the app open and nothing running, the server now rests.

sections.title: What this ship changes for you
items: With the app open and nothing running, the server now rests. On our own install its memory at rest went from 1.4 GB to about 290 MB, and its CPU from 18% of a core to between 1% and 5%.
A window left in front with nothing happening sends no requests once it has loaded. It used to send about 120 a minute.
The server keeps answering while macOS shows a file-access prompt for a repository in Documents, Desktop, Downloads or on an external drive. It used to stop until the prompt was answered.
The server answers requests while its startup maintenance is still running, and startup no longer blocks for several seconds on a large event history.
A worktree cleanup that cannot finish is tried again after a day. It used to be retried on every start, with its whole file list loaded into memory.
`o8 workspace-cleanup stuck-purges` lists the cleanups that can never finish and abandons the ones you choose. It shows a dry run unless you add `--apply`, and it leaves the folders on disk.
`o8 mission archive --acknowledge-missing-worktree` closes a mission whose worker session and worktree are already gone.
The launcher sleeps until one of its processes needs it. It used to wake 40 times a second.

items: List and abandon managed retirements stuck in purging

sections.title: Performance
items: Stop waking at rest when nothing changed
Tell the window when opened files are waiting
Read only the reviewing lanes when deciding to rerun the stall pass
Stop blocking the event loop for seconds at startup
Skip a settled shared-team repair while nothing it reads changed
Sleep until something happens instead of ticking every 25 ms
Scan listening ports only when they change
Reuse an unchanged inbox snapshot instead of rebuilding it each poll

sections.title: Fixes
items: Log a recovery skip once per mission, not once per full tick
Keep answering while a repository waits on a macOS privacy prompt
Archive reset packets whose owned session and worktree are gone
Update status reads on a server notice, not every 2 s
Dock, usage, ports and bots read on change, not on timers
The sidebar rereads its catalog on stream events, not on timers
Reads the user did not cause no longer keep the idle gate awake
Agent views read on thread, agent and lane events, not on timers
